messages.subject: "Dependencies not available" - Package not installing on Linux
parts:
Hello everyone,

I would like to install SpaDES on my Linux computer, but each time I try (and I have tried with all possible codes on the package website) I get this kind of error :
'ERROR: dependencies ‘reproducible’, ‘SpaDES.addins’, ‘SpaDES.core’, ‘SpaDES.tools’ are not available for package ‘SpaDES’'.

Does someone have a solution for this issue ?

Thanks a lot !

Cheers,

Emmanuel

messages.author: 71df1ea0682dcc02
messages.subject: Re: "Dependencies not available" - Package not installing on Linux
parts:
Hi Emmanuel,

How are you installing SpaDES -- using install.packages()? Which Linux OS are you using? There are a number of system dependencies (not used by SpaDES directly but from some of its dependencies) that you likely don't have installed (take a look at the full output of the installation process -- it will tell you which dependency packages failed).

On Debian/Ubuntu you likely need:

sudo apt install \
fftw3 fftw3-dev \
gdal-bin \
libcairo2-dev \
libgdal-dev libgdal1-dev \
libgeos-dev libgeos++-dev \
libproj-dev \
libspatialite-dev \
libudunits2-dev \
libv8-dev \
libxt-dev \
python-gdal python3-gdal
